title: CSP Nonce-Based Security Implementation
description: Replaced 'unsafe-inline' in CSP with cryptographically secure nonce-based approach

changes.details: New CSP middleware with nonce generation using crypto.randomBytes(16)
Integrated nonce-based CSP headers into main middleware flow
React hook for client components to access CSP nonce
Added nonce to inline script for Supabase token cleanup
Removed CSP header from config (now handled by middleware)

security_improvements: Replaced 'unsafe-inline' in script-src with nonce-based approach
Replaced 'unsafe-inline' in style-src with nonce-based approach
Unique nonce generated for every request (prevents replay attacks)
Nonce exposed via X-CSP-Nonce header for client-side use
Regex escaping function to prevent injection attacks
backward_compatibility: Middleware generates nonce for all requests
Client components can access nonce via useCSPNonce hook
Inline scripts must use nonce attribute
Dev mode still allows 'unsafe-eval' for HMR
